tokens.name: studio-black
tokens.usage: The brand ink, from tailwind.config.js studio.black. Page ground in the Studio theme; type and button fills in Paper. Prefer the role tokens below in new work.

tokens.name: studio-white
tokens.usage: Paper white, from tailwind.config.js studio.white. Page ground in Paper; button type in Paper.

tokens.name: studio-slate
tokens.usage: Soft slate, from tailwind.config.js studio.slate. Input underlines, and the 20%-alpha card hairline in .card-luxury.

tokens.name: studio-gold
tokens.usage: Warm muted gold, from tailwind.config.js studio.gold. The one accent: selected service rows, tier numerals, validated-state icons, chart strokes. 2.42:1 on surface-page and 2.53:1 on surface-card in Paper, 6.88:1 in Studio. The owner has decided to keep the brand value exact, so the rule for new work is that in Paper it carries no body copy and no meaning on its own: put a word, border or icon beside it. The app already departs from that rule in three places, all pre-dating the decision: the StaffManager role label at 10px and its Reset to Studio Default button at 9px, and the MemberManager tier name at 30px, which misses even 3:1. The selected service row in BookingFlow, once a fourth, now also states its selection with aria-pressed and the word Selected. It also misses the 3:1 floor for a meaningful mark in Paper, so a gold border or icon there is decoration, not a signal. No value in its hue family clears 4.5:1 in both themes at once (reaching 4.83:1 in Paper costs the Studio theme, 3.45:1), which is why this is a usage rule rather than a re-tint.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Second chart series beside studio-gold, from the COLORS array in src/components/atelier/OverviewView.tsx. Fills and strokes only, never text.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground, set on body. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals and stat tiles. In Studio it equals surface-page, so a card is told apart by hairline alone, not by fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Hover ground under stat tiles and list rows, and the track behind MissionProgress.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-page and surface-card. 16.7:1 in Paper, 16.1:1 in Studio. Body copy with no explicit colour class inherits this pair through the body rules in src/index.css; the app also sets 136 elements in pure black and white with text-black and bg-black utilities, which the owner has chosen to keep as they are.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and descriptions on surface-page and surface-card. 4.6:1 in Paper, 6.8:1 in Studio.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and metadata on surface-page and surface-card. 4.63:1 on surface-page and 4.83:1 on surface-card in Paper, 4.76:1 in Studio. It was zinc-400 / zinc-500 and missed 4.5:1 in both themes; these values are the first in the same hue family that clear it. In Paper the threshold leaves no room above ink-muted, so the two are the same value there and the hierarchy is two tiers; in Studio it stays a dimmer third tier against ink-muted's 6.79:1.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Type and icons on interactive fills: primary buttons, the trend chip, selected time slots.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 10%-alpha rule that draws nearly every edge in the studio: card borders, lounge dividers, modal seams. The house separator.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Grid gaps and table rules where a 10% hairline disappears, as in the one-pixel gutters between stat tiles. 3.1:1 in Paper, 3.3:1 in Studio.

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected chips and slots, progress fill, and the focused input underline. The app's own buttons currently use pure black and white instead, which the owner has chosen to keep.

tokens.name: interactive-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover, from the hero CTA. Takes studio-white type in both themes.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Confirmed bookings, completed redemptions, points gained and granted validations. 4.81:1 on surface-page, 5.02:1 on surface-card and 4.79:1 on status-success-ground in Paper; 9.99:1 in Studio. It was Tailwind's green-600 (#16a34a, 3.16:1), which is not a brand colour, so it was darkened to green-700 to clear 4.5:1. Still pair it with a word, sign or icon so the state never rests on hue.

tokens.name: status-success-ground
tokens.usage: Fill behind a success message. Text on it takes ink or status-success, which reads 4.79:1 here in Paper.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Cancellations, validation errors and destructive confirmations. 4.63:1 on surface-page and 4.83:1 on surface-card in Paper, 6.29:1 in Studio: it clears 4.5:1 in both themes. Success and danger differ in lightness as well as hue, and both still name the state in words.

tokens.name: status-danger-ground
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error message. Text on it takes ink, or red-700 in Paper with red-400 in Studio as the app's alerts do (5.91:1 and 6.13:1 on the tint). status-danger reads only 4.41:1 here, so it is not used on this fill.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series in every Recharts figure: revenue line, bar fill, leading pie slice.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series, from the COLORS array in src/components/atelier/OverviewView.tsx.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series. It reads on Paper; on Studio it sits close to the ground, so a fifth slice there needs a hairline separator.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind a modal that blocks the flow, with a 12px backdrop blur. A side panel that does not block uses translucency and no scrim.

tokens.name: chrome-translucent
tokens.usage: The translucent material, as the bg-chrome class: the sticky landing navbar (with a 12px backdrop blur) and the sign-in card over the shader background (24px). White at 80% in Paper, zinc-900 at 80% in Studio, which is what both surfaces rendered before the token existed. The mobile menus are opaque surface-card, not this. Type on it goes at ink, never at ink-faint.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The landing headline: one line, italic light. Steps to 72px at tablet and 48px on a phone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles in the Atelier and the Lounge.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Panel headings, set uppercase in the archive and the portfolio.

styles.name: tier-name
styles.usage: The member tier inside the status card, centred over the progress arc. 32px on a phone.

styles.name: service-name
styles.usage: Service and barber names in booking rows, set uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy: service descriptions, policies, tier explanations. Hold the measure near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy, list rows and form help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase control labels: buttons, tabs, links. The tracking is what makes a short uppercase word read.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The studio signature over-label: tier caption, stat-tile label, section kicker. Uppercase, always above the thing it names.

styles.name: eyebrow-wide
styles.usage: The widest setting, kept for the business name above the hero and the footer location line.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Mission counters and timestamps. The floor: nothing is set smaller.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Ringgit prices in service rows, with tabular figures so the column aligns.

spacing.note: Tailwind's four-pixel scale as the app uses it, plus the studio's own 48px vertical rhythm and the two layout measures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps and chip insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: the trend chip's inset, badge rows on a phone.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Badge gaps and icon rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button groups, list-row padding, the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on a phone, and gaps between lounge panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding (.card-luxury) and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stat-tile padding and the hero CTA's horizontal inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The vertical rhythm base: the minimum air between two sections. Never less.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Air between major regions on a desktop page, and between the two Atelier chart panels.

tokens.name: measure-lounge
tokens.usage: Maximum content width in the Member Lounge, so one column stays readable.

tokens.name: measure-admin
tokens.usage: Maximum content width in the Atelier, where tables and charts need the room.

radius.note: The studio is square. Rounding is an exception that marks a dot, a pill or a portrait, never a default on cards.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything with an edge: cards, buttons, inputs, modals, chips, stat tiles. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The one softened corner in the app: the inner end of a horizontal bar in a Recharts figure.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: barber avatars, mission bullets, the selected radio dot.

shadow.note: Edges are drawn with hairline, not with elevation. A shadow appears only on a layer that has left the page plane.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs and buttons. The studio separates by rule, not by lift.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, the mobile menu and the install prompt: anything floating above the page. Pair with scrim when it blocks the flow.
